resources.string: How to Use the Report Reader
4 simple steps: scan, verify, translate & listen
Scan or Upload Any Lab Report
Take a clear photo of a paper lab sheet using Scan My Report, or upload a PDF, JPG, or PNG file up to 15 MB. You can also choose which family member the report belongs to.
Keep all four corners bright and sharp so test numbers and reference ranges stay easy to read.
Illustration of scanning and uploading a medical lab report
NexzyHealth organizes your lab parameters into clear rows showing measured values, units, and reference ranges, while flagging urgent or out-of-range markers for quick attention.
Double-check the extracted numbers against your original lab sheet before generating your explanation.
Illustration of structured medical test parameters and status indicators
After your explicit consent, read a simple explanation written at an everyday reading level in English, Hindi, Bengali, or Marathi—or play hands-free audio narration.
Switch languages anytime from the top bar on Home or inside your profile settings.
Illustration of plain-language medical explanation and audio voice playback
AI summaries help you understand medical terms and prepare better questions for your doctor. They do not replace professional medical advice or diagnosis.
Want to explore first? Try the interactive Complete Blood Count (CBC) Demo before uploading your own file.
Illustration of protective healthcare privacy shield guarding a medical report
Choose Keep to securely store this report and its explanations for 7 days from upload, or Delete to remove it now. Leaving without choosing deletes it automatically.
